chapter: Ellington band: drinking, quarrels and rent parties
title: Whether Duke drank, and the rent parties
summary: Duke was not a heavy drinker in Bigard's time; the rent parties, or chitlin switches, served the world's worst bathtub gin.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I know in the years that I knew Duke, Duke hardly drank at all, very, very little. But he told me -- he used to brag, in fact -- that he used to be a heavy drinker. He said, "Back in the days of the rent parties" --
-- he could put away a lot. Was he a heavy drinker when you first joined the band?
No, not as I know of.

Well, you see, those guys used to play those -- they called them "chitlin switches" and that's their rent parties, you know, house rent parties. That's so they can get enough money to pay the rent, and they used to have all kind of -- bathtub gin and all, the world's worst.
But Duke was no heavy drinker, not when I was in the band.
